result.stdout:
ClockTray - Toggle Windows taskbar clock visibility

USAGE:
  clocktray              Launch system tray app (GUI mode)
  clocktray show         Show the taskbar clock
  clocktray hide         Hide the taskbar clock
  clocktray status       Check clock visibility status
  clocktray --help       Display this help
  clocktray --version    Display version

GUI Mode:
  - Runs in system tray with context menu
  - Global hotkey: Ctrl+Alt+T

CLI Mode:
  - Runs headlessly (no UI, exits after action)
  - Supports Windows 11 23H2+ modern method (instant)
  - Falls back to legacy policy key on older Windows
